solutions.title: Case Studies
solutions.subtitle: How we turn complex challenges into measurable business success

case1.title: Turning Sluggishness into Sales
case1.problem: An e-commerce store losing 70% of visitors due to a 5-second page load time.
case1.solution: Rebuilt using Nuxt 3, optimized imagery, and set up advanced edge caching.
case1.impact: Page speed reduced to 0.8s, resulting in a 45% increase in sales.

case2.title: Dominating Search Results
case2.problem: A premium real estate developer invisible on the first page of Google KSA.
case2.solution: Conducted a complete technical SEO audit and restructured property content layout.
case2.impact: Ranked #1 for 15 primary keywords, driving a 300% growth in qualified leads.

case3.title: Automating Complex Workflows
case3.problem: Booking appointments manually was wasting 4 hours of medical staff time daily.
case3.solution: Built a custom automation system connecting the site with WhatsApp API and Google Calendar.
case3.impact: Saved 20 hours per week and reduced appointment errors by 95%.
